setup_guide.introduction: I'll check your software's documented rules against source code and explain Pass, Fail or Unknown with evidence. Choose the source code folder. You'll review and approve the exact rule list before I verify it; I won't execute or edit the code.

real.introduction: Choose a local folder containing source and requirements. I'll prepare the rules for your approval, then report the evidence and any unknowns for each approved rule.
